about.title: About Houston Area Pools and Patios
text: We are a veteran owned pool company located in Pearland, TX. We specialize in new pool construction, remodels, and monthly service. We started with the service side before jumping into the construction. We felt that it would give us a better understanding of what really makes a pool truly great and enjoyable.
We are focused on the attention to detail and will physically be on site during the whole process. Get in touch with us today for a free consultation.

We are focused on designing the perfect pool of your dreams. We provide 3D renderings to come up with the perfect design while working together with the customer. Getting the perfect design is important, but what really counts is what you don't see. We are consistently on site to make sure no details are missed.
